items.name: MotorSport Vision (MSV)
items.notes: Largest UK circuit group. Operates Brands Hatch, Donington Park, Cadwell Park, Snetterton and Oulton Park. Also runs MSV Bike Trackdays (bike.msvtrackdays.com).

items.name: MSVR (MotorSport Vision Racing)
items.notes: Promotes BSB and support championships. Works under MCRCB governance.

items.name: Knockhill Racing Circuit
items.notes: Scotland's only motorsport complex; hosts BSB rounds and SACU club events. Track days and coaching available.

items.name: Anglesey Circuit (Trac Môn)
items.notes: North Wales circuit with International and Coastal layouts. Popular for club racing and track days.

items.name: Castle Combe Circuit
items.notes: Historic Wiltshire circuit; motorcycle track days (experienced riders) and club racing. Not an MSV venue.

items.name: Pembrey Circuit
items.notes: Welsh circuit near Llanelli; 5 layout variants; club racing and track days.

items.name: Thruxton Motorsport Centre
items.notes: UK's fastest circuit; Hampshire. BSB venue; also track days and club racing.

items.name: Goodwood Motor Circuit
items.notes: Historic West Sussex circuit; primarily used for Goodwood Revival (classic cars) and motorcycle events.

items.name: Scarborough & District MC — Oliver's Mount
items.notes: Organises road race meetings at Oliver's Mount, Scarborough — England's only purpose-built road race circuit.

items.name: Isle of Man TT Races
items.notes: Organises IOM TT and Classic TT. Under IOM Government / ACM oversight.

items.name: North West 200 Organisation
items.notes: Annual May public-road event near Portstewart/Portrush/Coleraine.

items.name: ACU / Sport80 online licensing
items.notes: Online portal for ACU membership, competition licence applications and upgrade submissions.
